title: Rotative Factorization Machines

problem.claim: Feature interaction learning aims to capture complex relationships among multiple features for predictive modeling.

gap.claim: Existing feature interaction learning methods have limitations in modeling interaction orders and feature dependencies across varying contexts.

narrative_sequence.summary: Feature interaction learning is used to model complex relationships among multiple features in predictive tasks.
Existing methods are limited by bounded interaction orders and independently learned interaction orders that do not flexibly capture contextual feature dependencies.

unknowns: The proposed method and its mechanism are not described.
